# Default kernel command line for Raspberry Pi systems using
# bootchain-rpi, fallback when /etc/kernel/cmdline does not exist.
#
# Do NOT edit cmdline.txt on the boot partition, it is regenerated from
# those files on every kernel deployment.
#
# After creating or changing either file, re-render the boot partition:
#   kernel-install add-all

rw rootwait console=serial0,115200 console=tty1 fsck.repair=yes
